speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether the Ministry will consider extending the smoking prohibition at any playground or exercise area to also include any area within a radius of 5 metres from the outer edge of the playground or exercise area.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Which is why I hope that the review will consider making it just a five-metre radius from the outer perimeter of the exercise area or the playground.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Considering as well that these are areas where people are exercising and our children are playing, we really should not have second-hand smoke.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: There are jurisdictions in other countries that have implemented this.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: At the end of the day, all stakeholders have to play their part and exercise civic-mindedness and social responsibility.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, as soon as we have made the decision, we will make the announcements.
